title: FBI-UAP-D022, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-6, Western United States Event, 2026
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 sighting reported by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: A federal law enforcement special agent reported observing a glowing yellow orb hovering above a road near a sensitive national security site in the western United States.
incidents.quote: hovering above the road and slightly to the right, is a bright, glowing yellow orb
